desc.en: In his book of al-Mazar, Sayyid Ibn Tawus says: After completing the Ziyarat of Imam Musa Kazim (a), stand near the grave of Imam Mohammad Taqi (a), kiss it and recite…
desc.rurdu: Sayyad ibne Tawus apni kitaab Al-Mazar mein farmaate hai keh: Imam Musa Kazim (a) ki ziyarat karne ke baad, ab Imam Muhammad Taqi (a) ki qabr mubarak ke saamne khade ho kar is tarah padhe…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اَبَا جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَلِیِّ

الْبَرَّ التَّقِیَّ الْاِمَامَ الْوَفِیَّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الرَّضِیُّ الزَّكِیُّ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا وَلِیَّ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا نَجِیَّ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا سَفِیْرَ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا سِرَّ اللہِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA ABAA JA’FARIN MOHAMMADABNA A’LAIYYENIL BARRAT TAQIYYAL EMAAMAL WAFIYYA AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAR RAZIYYUZ ZAKIYYO AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA WALIYAL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA NAJIYYAL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA SAFEERAL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA SIRRAL LAAHE.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O Abu Ja`far Muhammad the son of Ali, the righteous, pious, and faithful leader. Peace be upon you, O pleased and pure. Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant. Peace be upon you, O confidentially talked by Allah. Peace be upon you, O Allah’s emissary. Peace be upon you, O Allah’s secret. Peace be upon you, O Allah’s brightness.
trans.rurdu: Aap par salaam ho ay Abu Jafar, Muhammad bin Ali (a.s). Neku-kaar, parhez-gaar, Imam wafa she’aar (wafa daar). Aap par salaam ho keh aap pasandida o paakeeza hai. Aap par salaam ho ay Waliye Khuda. Aap par salaam ho ay Khuda ke raazda’n. Aap par salaam ho ay Khuda ke numaainde. Salaam ho aap par ay raaze ilaahi.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا ضِیَآءَ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا سَنَآءَ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا كَلِمَۃَ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا رَحْمَۃَ اللہِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا النُّوْرُ السَّاطِعُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْبَدْرُ الطَّالِعُ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الطَّیِّبُ مِنَ الطِّیِّبِیْنَ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA ZEYAAA-AL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA SANAAA-AL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA KALEMATAL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA RAHMATAL LAAHE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAN NOORUS SAA-TE-O’ AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAL BADRUT TAALE-O’ AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAT TAYYEBO MENAT TAYYEBEENA.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s brilliance. Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Word. Peace be upon you, O Allah’s mercy. Peace be upon you, O shining light. Peace be upon you, O rising full moon. Peace be upon you, O pure who is the descendant of the pure ones.
trans.rurdu: Aap par salaam ho ay Khuda ki roshni. Aap par salaam ho ay Khuda se roshan shudah. Aap par salaam ho ay Khuda ke kalaam. Aap par salaam ho ay Khuda ki rehmat. Aap par salaam ho keh aap chamakta huwa noor hai. Aap par salaam ho keh aap chaudhawi ka chaand hai. Aap par salaam ho keh aap paak hai paakeeza logo’n mein se hai. Aap par salaam ho keh aap paak shudah aur paak logo’n mein se hai.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الطَّاهِرُ مِنَ الْمُطَهَّرِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْاٰیَۃُ الْعُظْمٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْحُجَّۃُ الْكُبْرٰی۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُطَهَّرُ مِنَ الزَّلَّاتِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْمُنَزَّهُ عَنِ الْمُعْضِلَاتِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAT TAAHERO MENAL MOTAHHAREENA AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAL AAYATUL U’ZMAA AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAL HUJJATUL KUBRAA AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAL MOTAHHARO MENAZ ZALLAATE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAL MONAZZA-HO A’NIL MO’ZELAATE.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O immaculate who is the descendant of the immaculate ones. Peace be upon you, O greatest sign. Peace be upon you, O grandest argument. Peace be upon you, O purified from slips. Peace be upon you, O deemed above unforgivable failings.
trans.rurdu: Aap par salaam ho keh aap bohot badi nishaani hai. Aap par salaam ho keh aap bohot badi daleel hai. Aap par salaam ho keh aap khata o laghzish (galtiyo’n) se paak hai. Aap par salaam ho keh aap munazzah (paak o paakeeza) hai us se keh mushkil masaael hal na kar paaye.

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الْعَلِیُّ عَنْ نَقْصِ الْاَوْصَافِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ اَیُّهَا الرَّضِیُّ عِنْدَ الْاَشْرَافِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا عَمُوْدَ الدِّیْنِ۔ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ وَلِیُّ اللہِ وَحُجَّتُهٗ فِیْ اَرْضِهٖ وَاَنَّكَ جَنْبُ اللہِ وَخِیَرَۃُ اللہِ وَمُسْتَوْدَعُ عِلْمِ اللہِ وَعِلْمِ الْاَنْبِیَآءِ وَرُكْنُ الْاِیْمَانِ وَتَرْجُمَانُ الْقُرْاٰنِ۔

lines.rarabic: AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAL A’LIYYO A’N NAQSIL AWSAAFE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA AYYOHAR RAZIYYO I’NDAL ASHRAAFE AS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA YAA A’MOODAD DEENE ASH-HADO ANNAKA WALIYYUL LAAHE WA HUJJATOHU FEE ARZEHI WA ANNAKA JAMBUL LAAHE WA KHEYARATUL LAAHE WA MUSTAWDA-O’ I’LMIL LAAHE WA I’LMIL AMBEYAAA-E WA RUKNUL EEMAANE WA TARJOMAANIL QUR-AANE.

trans.en: Peace be upon you, O raised high against imperfect traits. Peace be upon you, O pleased in the sight of the honorable ones. Peace be upon you, O pillar of the religion. I bear witness that you are the intimate servant of Allah, the argument of Him in His lands, the side of Allah, the best in the view of Allah, the store of the knowledge of Allah and the knowledge of the Prophets, the cornerstone of faith, and the interpreter of the Qur’an.
trans.rurdu: Salaam ho aap par keh aap buland hai us se keh ausaaf mein kuchh kami paayi jaaye. Aap par salaam ho keh aap saahebaane martaba ke nazdik hai. Aap par salaam ho ay deen keh sutoon (pillar). Mai gawahi deta hu keh aap Khuda ke Wali aur zameen mein uski Hujjat hai. Aap Khuda ke taraf daar aur uske chune huwe hai. Aap ilm’e ilaahi aur ilm’e ambiya ke amaanat daar hai aur aap imaan ka paaya aur Qur’an ke share (wazhaat karne waale) hai.

arabic.text: وَاَشْهَدُ اَنَّ مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ عَلَی الْحَقِّ وَالْهُدٰی وَاَنَّ مَنْ اَنْكَرَكَ وَنَصَبَ لَكَ الْعَدَاوَۃَ عَلَی الضَّلَالَۃِ وَالرَّدٰی اَبْرَءُ اِلَی اللہِ وَاِلَیْكَ مِنْهُمْ فِیْ الدُّنْیَا وَالْاٰخِرَۃِ۔ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ مَا بَقِیْتُ وَبَقِیَ اللَّیْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ۔

lines.rarabic: WA ASH-HADO ANNA MANIT TA-BA-A’KA A’LAL HAQQE WAL-HODAA WA ANNA MAN ANKARAKA WA NASABA LAKAL A’DAAWATA A’LAZ ZALAALATE WAR-RADAA AB-RA-O ELAL LAAHE WA ILAIKA MINHUM FID-DUNYAA WAL-AAKHERATE WAS-SALAAMO A’LAIKA MAA BAQEETO WA BAQEYAL LAYLO WAN-NAHAARO.

trans.en: I also bear witness that whoever follows you has been on the right and true guidance but whoever denies you and incurs your animosity has been on deviation and perdition. I repudiate these in the presence of Allah and you in this world and in the Hereafter. Peace be upon you as long as I am existent and as long as there are day and night.
trans.rurdu: Mai gawahi deta hu keh be-shak aap ki pairwi haq o hidaayat par saabit qadam hai aur aap ka inkaar karne waala aur aap se adaawat rakhne waala gumraahi aur halaakat mein bada hai, aap ke aur Khuda ke saamne aise logo’n se duniya o aakherat mein be-zaar hu. Aap par salaam ho jab tak mai baaqi rahu aur shab o roz baaqi hai.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔

desc.en: You may now pray for your needs.
